$$
\int 3 x \cot{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)} \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "f5308edd-7673-58fe-9d05-ac0871e43493" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=x^{2} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 3 x \cot{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)} \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \csc{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- \frac{3 \csc{\left(u \right)}}{2}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
- \frac{3 \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}}{2}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "f5308edd-7673-58fe-9d05-ac0871e43493" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "f5308edd-7673-58fe-9d05-ac0871e43493" :question/answer-fields "e0be59d9-b5a8-5760-be31-45b6eaff99a3"] [:db/ensure "f5308edd-7673-58fe-9d05-ac0871e43493" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068917 :knowledge-point/questions "f5308edd-7673-58fe-9d05-ac0871e43493"] [:db/add "cc1437e3-3127-553e-aff2-8606aa433d0d" :answer/id #uuid "cc1437e3-3127-553e-aff2-8606aa433d0d"] [:db/add "cc1437e3-3127-553e-aff2-8606aa433d0d" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "cc1437e3-3127-553e-aff2-8606aa433d0d" :answer/value "- \cos{\left(x^{2} + 1 \right)}"] [:db/ensure "cc1437e3-3127-553e-aff2-8606aa433d0d" :answer/validate] [:db/add "c4fc48b1-8659-572c-8200-8f98e6cf48c9" :answer-field/id #uuid "c4fc48b1-8659-572c-8200-8f98e6cf48c9"] [:db/add "c4fc48b1-8659-572c-8200-8f98e6cf48c9" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "c4fc48b1-8659-572c-8200-8f98e6cf48c9" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "c4fc48b1-8659-572c-8200-8f98e6cf48c9" :answer-field/choices "cc1437e3-3127-553e-aff2-8606aa433d0d"] [:db/add "c4fc48b1-8659-572c-8200-8f98e6cf48c9" :answer-field/correct "cc1437e3-3127-553e-aff2-8606aa433d0d"] [:db/ensure "c4fc48b1-8659-572c-8200-8f98e6cf48c9" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "ddddb292-1f71-57a4-beb3-28f714287ab4" :question/id #uuid "ddddb292-1f71-57a4-beb3-28f714287ab4"] [:db/add "ddddb292-1f71-57a4-beb3-28f714287ab4" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.
